components.name: Portfolio Accounting Reader
components.existingImplementation: Implemented integrity-checked ledger read in a transaction and existing deterministic reconstructPortfolio; read-only subset used by CurrentNavReadService.
components.missingFunctionality: Restrict deployment access to read-only handles; bind real account/perimeter and a consistent revision/facts hash; no write port exposed.
components.inputContract: portfolioId, ledgerRevision, T, K, approved accounting implementation
components.outputContract: immutable history, factsHash, stateHash, state(T), supported opening boundary
components.trustBoundary: Saved ledger integrity does not certify external completeness.
components.evidenceRequirements: Exact facts/legs, registry method, accepted starting balances and forward coverage
components.failureBehavior: integrity/revision/knowledge mismatch -> NAV_BLOCKED; no projection fallback
components.ownership: Accounting engineer; financial acceptance by distinct reviewer

components.name: Broker Evidence Reader
components.existingImplementation: Retained broker PDF/API observations and research loaders exist, not a CurrentNavInputProvider or authenticated NAV acceptance reader.
components.missingFunctionality: Bounded immutable byte reader/decoder preserving account, times, precision, original fields and conflicts; accepted-source lookup.
components.inputContract: content-addressed document/capture inventory plus exact account/perimeter and scope
components.outputContract: BrokerEvidenceBundle proposal, normalized observations with pointers and unresolved discrepancies
components.trustBoundary: Provider data and parsed values are not accepted accounting facts.
components.evidenceRequirements: Source bytes/hash, account linkage, capture/document identity, source contract and disjoint field semantics
components.failureBehavior: missing/corrupt/ambiguous/date-only unproved cutoff -> blocked; no balancing record
components.ownership: Broker supplies records; evidence producer prepares; financial reviewer accepts

components.name: Securities Identity Resolver
components.existingImplementation: Offline immutable bridge structural resolver returns acceptedMapping:false; calculator checks identity/partition/reverse uniqueness.
components.missingFunctionality: Revocation-aware accepted continuity resolver for all held units; no accepted mappings currently established.
components.inputContract: ledger namespace/ID, market namespace/UUID/code/ISIN, venue/class, T/K, bridge pins
components.outputContract: one exact eligible mapping per economic unit, interval and acceptance evidence; otherwise reasons
components.trustBoundary: Ticker/code coincidence is insufficient; provider ISIN is not independent acceptance.
components.evidenceRequirements: Account anchor, market anchor, effective/knowledge intervals and lifecycle witnesses
components.failureBehavior: zero/multiple/overlap/reuse/uncertain CA -> blocked; never rewrite ledger IDs
components.ownership: Identity reviewer distinct from bridge producer

components.name: Market Price Evidence Reader
components.existingImplementation: Existing acquisition, lossless raw parser, EOD normalizer and replay pipeline; VALUATION-only trusted composition.
components.missingFunctionality: Read-only NAV translation/qualification with purpose-specific source/calendar/finality grants; no new client.
components.inputContract: pinned raw manifests/board/master, accepted mapping, exact session and price policy
components.outputContract: CurrentNavPriceV1 rows with RAW price/identity/source/CA pins, or unavailable
components.trustBoundary: Technical EOD normalization is neither exchange finality nor PORTFOLIO_NAV source authority.
components.evidenceRequirements: Raw SHA-256, request/response lineage, board-date match, unit contract, accepted policy/finality
components.ownership: Market-data engineer prepares; independent market-source reviewer accepts

components.name: Trading Calendar Resolver
components.existingImplementation: Technical 2026 calendar/session helpers exist; accepted NAV calendar absent.
components.missingFunctionality: Accepted schedule/exceptions/closure/finality resolver with exclusive next-completed boundary, expiry and revocation.
components.inputContract: valuation request/time, venue, accepted calendar and NAV price-policy pins
components.trustBoundary: Local date or weekday heuristic cannot establish accepted trading session.
components.evidenceRequirements: Calendar issuer/source records, exceptional closures, effective/knowledge interval, accepted exact policy
components.failureBehavior: missing exceptions/outside coverage/no completed session -> blocked
components.ownership: Calendar authority reviewer; owner approves NAV scope

components.name: Accounting Completeness Evaluator
components.existingImplementation: NAV ten-dimension gate and unchanged exact full reconciliation; dividend/intake contracts and guards implemented, prepared migrations unapplied.
components.missingFunctionality: Evidence-backed evaluator assembling coherent economic completeness, forward continuity and NAV-only addendum, retaining full legacy reconciliation.
components.inputContract: A/B/C outputs, accepted opening/coverage/claim/action/obligation witnesses atT/K
components.outputContract: CurrentNavPlanV1 completeness/components/unit partitions and limitations; raw legacy report hash
components.trustBoundary: Import/replay/PASS alone cannot assert completeness; writes are outside this flow.
components.evidenceRequirements: No gaps/duplicates, exact reconciled cash/claims/debt/quantity/rights; accounting scope acceptance
components.failureBehavior: unknown liability/claim/continuity/CA/conflict -> blocked even indicative; basis partial only with no economic effect
components.ownership: Accounting producer; financial reviewer validates independently

components.name: Source Authority Verifier
components.existingImplementation: NavQualificationAuthorityV1 synchronous interface and retained-market trusted bindings exist; real NAV verifier/authenticated records absent. PEC-1C provider/executor neutral contracts remain fail closed.
components.missingFunctionality: Server-only verification of authenticated role/scoped grants, bytes, intervals, revocation and supersession; approved trust infrastructure prerequisite.
components.inputContract: Pinned decision envelope + issuer/reviewer/role-grant audit + exact subject hashes
components.outputContract: exact NavAuthorityProofV1 projection for requested kind/hash/portfolio/purpose; no extra serialized fields
components.trustBoundary: Local JSON, OS identity, Codex output and synthetic verifier cannot authenticate authority.
components.evidenceRequirements: Authentic decision, authorized role, source/interpretation scope, current revocation and audit anchor
components.failureBehavior: unknown signature/issuer/role/revocation/scope -> no proof/block; never auto-create approval
components.ownership: Security/governance reviewer; owner chooses future trust mechanism

components.name: Independent Acceptance Verifier
components.existingImplementation: Distinct producer/validator fields enforced; only synthetic trusted verifier in tests. No operational independent NAV acceptance.
components.missingFunctionality: Verify genuinely distinct authorized human reviewer and exact accepted bundle, not string inequality alone.
components.inputContract: AcceptanceSubjectV1 proposal, signed/audited reviewer decision and current role/revocation proof
components.outputContract: technical/financial/methodology acceptance results separately, exact subject hash proofs
components.trustBoundary: Same-person aliases or self-assigned distinct names fail separation of duties.
components.evidenceRequirements: Full bound bundle, reviewer identity and role/independence audit, limitations, decision time
components.failureBehavior: missing/self-review/stale/partial/wrong scope -> blocked; technical tests not substituted
components.ownership: Independent financial/system reviewer; no agent/self approval

components.name: Current NAV Calculator
components.existingImplementation: Approved isolated Phase3.2 calculator/read service; immutable manifests and all operational rights false.
components.missingFunctionality: Concrete CurrentNavInputProvider and securely prepared authority view; no arithmetic duplication or calculator edits in this phase.
components.trustBoundary: QUALIFIED_NAV is calculation qualification, never publication/release authority.
components.evidenceRequirements: All dependencies and proofs; exact revision/head checks; calculation version
components.failureBehavior: failed qualification -> null full totals; explicit indication only if coherent; races block

components.name: NAV Publication Gate
components.existingImplementation: Existing legacy dashboard/current composition and hard independent-market blocker; no CurrentNavReadService composition or NAV gate. V1 output explicitly denies official use.
components.missingFunctionality: Proposed separate release-gated publication envelope/view with an explicitly approved contract amendment before any integration.
components.inputContract: exact resultHash/runHash plus current ledger/evidence/authority heads, destination/purpose and publication/release decisions atP
components.outputContract: NavPublicationDecisionV1 proposal: DENY by default; explicit scoped destination envelope only after later authorization
components.trustBoundary: No copying qualified arithmetic into legacy current.nav or flipping V1 false flags; no read-driven approval/write.
components.evidenceRequirements: Authenticated operational permission + applicable release/M7 evidence + final atomic/current-head check
components.failureBehavior: missing authority/race/expiry/revocation/M7 restriction -> deny/hide official value; no cached stale fallback
components.ownership: Release owner and independent operational validator
